description.p: SenatorialNotes is a native Linux notes application that keeps ordinary Markdown files on your device. It has no accounts, cloud service, telemetry, analytics, advertising, or runtime networking.

It provides more than one vault with an in-app switcher, plain (Standard) and whole-vault-encrypted (Secure) vaults, a Markdown editor with live visual styling, atomic autosave, Trash and restore, nested notebooks, tags and tag filtering, Archive, Favourites, Pinned and Recently Opened views, user-controlled sorting, a Note Information panel, appearance preferences, individually encrypted notes, and an explicit export from a Secure Vault to a new plaintext Standard Vault. More note-management features are planned before 1.0.
The editor styles Markdown visually while keeping Markdown as the format on disk. Syntax markers stay visible but subdued rather than hidden; it is not a full WYSIWYG editor.

ul.li: More than one vault, with an in-app vault switcher and an advisory vault lock.
Standard Vaults (plaintext Markdown) and Secure Vaults (whole-vault encryption with a Vault Password).
Lossless migration of older single-version vaults to the Standard vault manifest.
Per-note encrypted notes continue to work, including as an inner layer inside a Secure Vault.
Export a Secure Vault to a new, separate plaintext Standard Vault, off the UI thread and re-asking for the Vault Password.
Detection of plaintext written into a Secure Vault by an incompatible version, with an explicit-consent quarantine that never deletes or imports.
Nested notebooks with safe create, rename, and delete.
Note movement between notebooks, including encrypted notes.
Tags and tag filtering, Archive, Pinned and Recently Edited views.
User-controlled sorting and composed notebook, tag, and search filtering.
A Note Information panel and keyboard-navigation improvements.
Editor V2 live visual Markdown styling; markers stay visible but subdued.
